fato_historico: 1944: World War II: Polish insurgents liberate a German labor camp (Gęsiówka) in Warsaw, freeing 348 Jewish prisoners.

It is a good time to shine your light into dark corners and reclaim your personal power with grace, hope, and unwavering resilience.
